📺 The Neighborhood (2018–Present)

The Neighborhood follows Dave Johnson, a friendly and optimistic man who moves with his wife Gemma and their son Grover from Michigan to a predominantly Black neighborhood in Pasadena, California. Excited to begin a new chapter, Dave quickly discovers that becoming friends with his next-door neighbor, Calvin Butler, won’t be easy. Calvin is a proud, outspoken family man who isn’t particularly impressed by Dave’s overly enthusiastic personality. Meanwhile, Calvin’s wife Tina and their sons Malcolm and Marty become increasingly involved in the Johnson family’s lives, creating hilarious misunderstandings, unexpected friendships, and unforgettable family moments. As the two households navigate cultural differences, relationships, parenting challenges, and everyday struggles, they gradually learn that friendship and understanding can bring people together. Starring Cedric the Entertainer, Max Greenfield, Tichina Arnold, Beth Behrs, Sheaun McKinney, and Marcel Spears, the series delivers heartwarming comedy, memorable characters, and meaningful stories about family, community, acceptance, and the importance of being good neighbors.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Family • Sitcom

⭐ IMDb: 6.7/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 22 minutes per episode • TV-PG

🎥 Creator: Jim Reynolds

📺 Seasons: 8 (final season)

📚 Setting: Pasadena, California

🏆 Awards: Received multiple NAACP Image Award nominations, including recognition for Cedric the Entertainer and Tichina Arnold.

📺 Where to Watch: CBS • Paramount+ (United States)
